svg.title: One display frame of KINETICKK
svg.desc: Left to right: input and frame time enter the tick, which runs fixed steps of 1/120 of a second in place; the tick publishes a typed render model and an interpolation alpha; the Compose Canvas draws the world, FX and HUD from them. Below, a timeline shows simulation steps at an even 120 Hz and display frames at their own rate; each frame draws the last step plus the alpha that measures how far it lies toward the next step.
